objective: Review the newest commit on release/0.3.0/feat/pi-t3-host (T3 Code detection, the T3 tool filter with drift correction and tool_call backstop, and the Full-access warning in the HolyAgent Pi extension) against the T3 Intent requirements it implements.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-t3host; diff HEAD~1..HEAD (sources and tests in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/t3host-review.diff).

Requirements: under T3 (ctx.mode rpc plus T3_PI_RUNTIME_MODE or T3_MCP_URL) the root keeps html_render, html_preview, preview_*, t3_preview_*, device_* of mcp__t3-code__ and its hidden alias mcp__t3_code__, and deactivates every other T3 tool; set once at session_start, restored on before_agent_start and session_tree only after drift so the tool list stays stable for prompt caching; a tool_call block refuses a deactivated T3 tool (also one reached through tool_search); below Full access (T3_PI_RUNTIME_MODE approval-required or auto-accept-edits) one warning through the notice path and setStatus; no change outside T3; the extension calls no custom, setWidget, setFooter, setHeader, setTitle or theme under rpc.
Research behind it: /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw8tdgpq-hfsl.md (T3 bridge) and assignment-0mw8td52p-27ab.md (Pi API).

Check also: interaction with the existing root tool selection and excluded tools, child and specialist sessions, the pi.test.ts handler-list change, and whether an unset T3_PI_RUNTIME_MODE under T3 is handled as the bridge does.
constraints: Read-only; you may run bun test and mise run verify in that worktree.
Mark a finding blocking only when behaviour is wrong, incomplete, untested on an error path, or breaks existing behaviour; give path:line and a failure scenario.

criteria.text: Every blocking finding has path:line and a failure scenario
The review states whether each listed requirement is met

result:
result: No blockers. Every listed requirement is met. `mise run verify` passes (2492 tests); `bun test` on the pi and runtime pi tests passes (461 tests).

blockers: none

**findings** (all optional)
1. `packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts:1283`: `t3Root` is set before `applyRootTools` runs, so it stays true if `setActiveTools` throws. The next turn's drift correction and the gate then act on a start that never applied. The effect is benign: the extra stripping and refusing is what the root wants anyway. It is untested, since the error path has no T3 case.
2. `packages/runtime/src/pi/tools.ts:73`: `isDeactivatedT3Tool` compiles up to six RegExps per call through `toolMatches`. It now runs on every `tool_call` for a T3 root and for each registered tool at `before_agent_start` and `session_tree`. This is small and optional.
3. The `t3*code` wildcard in `T3_PREFIX` also matches look-alike server names. Pre-existing convention.
4. `extension.ts:1384`: the drift handler depends on the first `before_agent_start` handler awaiting the start's collection. Pi runs the handlers in registration order and the first one awaits `pending`, so it holds today, and the `tool_call` gate backs it up. I could not run T3's bridge, so I could not check where its own `before_agent_start` re-add falls relative to ours. `model_select` drift is corrected at the next `before_agent_start`.
5. The comment in `t3.ts` says the gate also covers a `codemode` script's calls. I only read it and did not verify that those calls go through `tool_call`.

**verdict:** merge-ready.

**Requirements**
Filter keeps `html_render`, `html_preview`, `preview_*`, `t3_preview_*` and `device_*` in both spellings and removes all other T3 tools: met (`tools.ts:73`, tests with the `something_new` and `html_render_all` cases).
Set once at start, restored on `before_agent_start` and `session_tree` only after drift, byte-stable otherwise: met. `holdT3ToolsOff` writes only when drifted tools are present, and the test asserts no `setActiveTools` call when nothing drifted.
`tool_call` block, also for tools registered later or reached through `tool_search`: met, by name and independent of the active set.
Warning below Full access: met. One notice plus `setStatus` for `approval-required` and `auto-accept-edits`, delivered once. An unset mode is not below Full access, as in the bridge (research report line 17); under T3 with an unset mode, `T3_MCP_URL` still marks the session as T3.
No change outside T3, including a T3 variable in tui mode or an empty value: met, tested.
No `custom`, `setWidget`, `setFooter`, `setHeader`, `setTitle` or theme calls: met. The recording-proxy test sees only `setStatus`.
Existing root selection: met. T3 names go into `excludeTools` as exact names, so Windows `powershell` and the existing exclusions are untouched. `taken.excluded` is separate, so `refuseExcludedTool` is unaffected.
Child sessions: met. Their collection returns no tools, so `t3Root` stays false and they keep their tools and get no warning (tested).
`pi.test.ts` handler list: matches, with one extra `before_agent_start` and a `session_tree` handler.
